source: NoProxyHostMockingIntegrationTest. An httpForward (or httpForwardWithFallback) names its target explicitly, so NettyHttpClient checks it against noProxyHosts (by host string, case-insensitively) and a listed host bypasses forwardHttpProxy (a refusing address: 502); an unlisted one still uses it. Targets taken from the Host header never bypass it (proxy_configuration_forward_http). Each forward is used once, so the second arrival of its path is answered by the plain expectation

steps.note: explicit target on noProxyHosts: connects directly
explicit target not on the list: goes through forwardHttpProxy
the unlisted forward never reached its target
httpForwardWithFallback names its target explicitly too
